servers.desc: Shared upstream library: alias, address, TCP/UDP, and enable.
servers.add_description: Creates an upstream only — no forwards.
servers.name: Name
servers.port_enable_hint: Fill a port to enable that protocol; leave empty to skip.
servers.need_ports: Enter at least one TCP or UDP port
servers.confirm_body: Deletes “%s” and its forwards. Irreversible until you restore from Changes.
servers.empty_hint: Add an upstream, or use Quick onboard for a batch.
servers.promote_hint: Enable production forwards for this upstream; creates them if missing.
servers.promote_confirm: Enable production forwards for %s? (Validation stays unchanged; missing forwards are created.)
servers.quick_description: Batch-write upstreams, optionally with first production entries (validation optional).
servers.quick_done_body: Upstreams written. Checked entries are created too.
servers.quick_need_rows: Add at least one valid upstream row
servers.quick_paste_hint: One per line: alias IP:port, e.g. server-01 185.244.208.205:4301

rules.empty_hint: Add a forward with an upstream and entry type.

acl.empty_hint: Add a CIDR or IP to this list.
config.title: Config
config.desc: Edit and save the full YAML config.
config.edit_warning: Save replaces the whole file and overwrites unsaved form edits.
config.saved_hint: Not applied on this gateway yet:
config.toast_conflict: File changed elsewhere; reloaded — edit again
apply.title: Apply
apply.desc: Apply config or firewall on this host, or publish a config version to the fleet.
apply.risk_body: Hot apply: no drain, no Envoy restart. Hard reload: drain + restart; sessions on this host drop. Fleet publish never triggers a global hard restart.
apply.publish_confirm_body: Publishes current config as a new fleet version; gateway nodes pull and hot-apply locally. Misaligned nodes can be retried — no automatic global hard restart.
apply.reload_confirm_body: Backs up, renders, and hard-restarts Envoy on this host. Impact: all existing TCP/UDP sessions on this gateway drop and must reconnect.
apply.hot_confirm_body: Backs up and hot-applies config on this host (no drain, no Envoy restart). Unrelated sessions usually stay; flows on changed/removed listeners may drop.
apply.fw_confirm_body: Flushes and loads nftables; host ingress may briefly change. Mistakes can drop remote sessions — keep this session and have cloud console ready.
apply.none_hint: No pending summaries or results yet.
ops.title: Ops
ops.desc: Local diagnostics, drain, smoke/canary, firewall check, rate limits, and profiles.
fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.desc: Gateway-node registry, publish overview, join and leave.
fleet.list_desc: Gateway nodes in the registry and their alignment.
fleet.empty_hint: Use Join node to generate an install command; install and start the agent on the target host.
fleet.join_desc: Generate a one-line install command to install a gateway node and connect it to control.
fleet.join_command_hint: Run as root on the target host. Contains a one-time token — do not post publicly.
fleet.leave_desc: Remove a gateway node from the registry and revoke its agent token.
fleet.leave_confirm_body: Removes the gateway node from the registry and revokes its agent credential.
fleet.leave_empty: No retireable gateway nodes in the registry.
fleet.manual_nlb: Remaining manual step (optional cloud front door)
fleet.toast_copy_err: Copy failed; select the command manually
ops.drain_confirm_fail: This host will fail health probes and stop taking new connections. Existing sessions usually stay; on a single node this gateway accepts no new traffic. An optional cloud front door may drop this node.
ops.drain_confirm_ok: Restores health probes so this host takes new connections again. An optional cloud front door may re-include this node.
ops.drain_hint: Stops new traffic; may wait tens of seconds. Existing connections usually remain.
ops.ratelimit_desc: Edit TCP and host-firewall per-IP rate-limit defaults.
ops.ratelimit_toast_conflict: Config changed elsewhere; reloaded — edit again
ops.profile_confirm_body: Writes host defaults only; does not restart Envoy. Apply config afterward to take effect (may interrupt connections).
ops.profile_empty_hint: This host has no ops profiles, or they failed to load.
ops.toast_fw_root: Firewall needs elevated helper — unavailable now
ops.fw_root_hint: Firewall helper is not ready. Confirm the privileged helper is installed and Panel can invoke it without a password, then restart the Panel service.
changes.title: Changes
changes.desc: Browse change summaries by timestamp; roll back when needed.
changes.rollback_body: Restores that stamp and restarts Envoy on this host. All existing connections on this gateway drop. Use a maintenance window or drain first.
changes.no_summary: (no summary file; stamp can still be rolled back)
monitoring.disabled: Monitoring is off. Configure Grafana URL, enable the Grafana component, then restart Panel.
servers.add_entry_description: Create missing validation or production entry forwards for this upstream.
servers.toast_entry_none: Entry already exists for %s — nothing created
rules.add_description: Pick an existing upstream plus entry type and protocols.
rules.enable_production_missing: No production forwards yet — add one first
apply.migrate_body: Hot apply is not available on this host yet; this apply will hard-reload Envoy. After that, hot apply works.
fleet.standby_body: Publish/join/leave are disabled on this read-only role. Use the control component.
